items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (constructConsistentHash, applyConsistentHash, mergeConsistentHash) and field docs exist. But the new types (ConsistentHashHeader etc.) have no type doc comments, and the 'Type aliases for convenience and flexibility' block is confusing extra API surface.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Follows the plugin pattern (IR, construct, apply, mergeXxx registered) and codegen was used. But it adds dead public API aliases (ConsistentHashPolicy = ConsistentHash, HashPolicyHeader...), and consistent_hash.go is large (~1300 new lines across the impl and test files).

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: CRD MinLength/MaxLength markers, a CEL disable rule, constructConsistentHash returning errors, and Validate registered. The TTL parse errors appear to be surfaced, but there is no check that the regex is valid at build time and no target-kind restriction.

items.name: Multi-policy merge semantics
items.evidence: mergeConsistentHash is registered in MergeTrafficPolicies. Tests check that both refs are recorded in MergeOrigins["consistentHash"], that sourceIp unset in p1 stays nil, that higher-priority disable suppresses lower, and that union/inheritance works. Hidden tests pass.

items.name: Empty spec and disable handling
items.name_zh: 空配置与 disable 处理
items.evidence: The CEL rule '!has(self.disable) || !self.disable || (!has(self.headers)...)' is on ConsistentHash and in the regenerated CRD. Empty {} defaults to sourceIp terminal=false, and disable gives nil HashPolicy (tested).
